initial_definition.name: brain_metastasis_status
initial_definition.description: Presence or absence of brain metastases identified in the pretreatment record.
initial_definition.measurement_definition: Determine if brain metastases are documented as present or absent based on radiology reports (primarily Brain MRI) or oncology notes. 'Present' is indicated by findings of intracranial metastases, enhancing brain lesions, or a diagnosis of brain metastases. 'Absent' is indicated by statements such as 'no intracranial metastases', 'brain MRI negative for intracranial metastases', or 'no evidence of intracranial metastatic disease'.
initial_definition.missing_value_rule: Represent as null if the pretreatment record contains no mention of brain imaging results or a definitive statement regarding the presence or absence of brain metastases.
